reviews.title: Excellent Cooler With a Great Screen — Read This Before Installing
reviews.comment:
I’m very impressed with the PCCOOLER GT360M. The build quality is solid, the cooling performance is strong, and the LCD screen is far more customizable than I expected. One of the biggest highlights is that you can upload short videos or create your own custom layouts, and the software makes it easy once everything is set up correctly.
Important: Download the Correct Software
You must download the software directly from the manufacturer’s website.
If you don’t, the LCD screen will show nothing at all.
Once the proper software is installed, the screen works perfectly and unlocks all the customization features.
The software lets you:
- Upload short videos
- Display CPU/GPU temps
- Create custom layouts
- Remove the small PCCOOLER trademark icon (just click it and delete it in the editor)
I have a short MSI dragon animation breathing fire on mine, along with my CPU and GPU temperatures, and it looks fantastic.
Cooling Performance
I’m using this on an Intel i7 14th‑gen, and the temps are excellent:
- Idle: usually between 37°C and 47°C
- Load: fans ramp up as expected, but the cooler keeps temps under control without any issues
For a 360mm AIO in this price range, the performance is genuinely impressive.
Installation Tips (Very Important)
This cooler comes with everything you need, including:
- All mounting hardware
- A proper backplate
- Thermal paste
- All screws and standoffs
A few key things to know:
1. Use the included hardware only
Do not reuse hardware from another AIO.
Different standoff heights or mounting pressure can cause your CPU to run too warm.
Use the hardware that comes with this cooler for proper contact.
2. Backplate has a peel‑off sticker
Make sure you remove the protective film on the backplate before installing it.
3. Correct pump orientation
For proper operation and correct screen orientation:
- Install the pump block with the hoses facing downward toward the bottom of your case.
4. Magnetic LCD screen
The display attaches magnetically to the pump.
I routed the screen’s USB cable up over the motherboard, down behind the tray, and back up to the USB 2.0 header for a clean look.
5. Connect all headers properly
The cooler requires:
- USB 2.0 header (for the screen)
- Pump header (PUMP_FAN)
- Fan headers for the radiator fans
- ARGB header for lighting
Once everything is connected correctly, the software recognizes it immediately.
Final Thoughts
This is a fantastic AIO for the price. The LCD screen is bright and customizable, the cooling performance is strong, and the installation is straightforward as long as you follow the steps and use the included hardware. If you download the correct software from the manufacturer’s website, the screen and customization features work flawlessly.
Highly recommended.
reviews.author: bikerider

reviews.title: Looks 10x better in person
reviews.comment: I’m very happy with this AIO. It arrived in great condition, well-packaged, and with no damage at all. The quality feels solid and reliable, and it honestly performed better than I expected. Installation was straightforward, and everything worked smoothly right out of the box. I love the clean look of the pumps; but my absolute favorite part, of course, is the display. Overall, it’s a great product for the price, and I would definitely recommend it.
reviews.author: Delilah Mejia

reviews.title: Easy to install, looks great and performs great.
reviews.comment: Used on my i7 12700kf. Went from 100c while running titles like bf6 with my old Apevia AIO that came with my prebuilt pc, to now running 45c on bf6 and 22c idle with this new AIO. Seen reviews on YouTube saying this AIO is extremely loud? But it is not in my experience. I am sat right next to it with open back headphones and don't even notice the sound at all. Overall really good for the price so far, and looks great.
